$comment: Frictionless Table Schema (https://specs.frictionlessdata.io/table-schema/). Tab-separated, UTF-8, one header row; columns appear in this order.
name: qc
title: qc.tsv
description: One row per searched file: the headline quality-control number of every QC output, so one table shows a whole run. Nothing here is computed twice: each column is the number its own output reports for that file. There is no total row, because a retention-time span and an identification rate do not pool across files. The per-bin detail is in qc.gradient.tsv, the digestion detail in digestion.tsv, the per-residue composition in qc.composition.tsv, the charge and chromatography rows in qc.chromatography.tsv, the per-modification occupancy in qc.modifications.tsv, and the polymer detail in run-summary.json under qc.polymers. A column whose pass measured nothing is empty, not zero.

fields.name: file
fields.description: Spectrum file name, as it appears in digestion.tsv and results.sage.parquet.

fields.name: ms1_spectra
fields.description: MS1 spectra read from the file; zero when the search did not need MS1.

fields.name: ms2_spectra
fields.description: Spectra of MS level 2 or above read from the file: the denominator of ms2_identified_pct.

fields.name: rt_start_min
fields.description: First scan start time read, in minutes.

fields.name: rt_end_min
fields.description: Last scan start time read, in minutes.

fields.name: ms1_read
fields.description: 1 when the file's MS1 spectra were read, 0 when they were not. Every MS1 column is zero because nothing was measured when this is 0, not because the measurement was zero.

fields.name: ms1_tic
fields.description: MS1 total ion current summed over the file: each spectrum's stated total ion current, or its summed peak intensity where the file states none. Includes profile spectra, unlike qc.polymers in run-summary.json.

fields.name: psms
fields.description: Rank-1 target peptide-spectrum matches at the q_value threshold.

fields.name: ms2_identified
fields.description: MS2 spectra carrying at least one of those PSMs. Lower than psms where a chimeric search reported several rank-1 PSMs for one spectrum.

fields.name: ms2_identified_pct
fields.description: 100 * ms2_identified / ms2_spectra. With dia.mode = "pseudo" the denominator is the acquired isolation windows while the PSMs come from pseudo-spectra built from them, so this can exceed 100.

fields.name: peptides
fields.description: Distinct target peptide sequences (modifications ignored) among PSMs that also pass the peptide q-value. Counts what was identified, with no decoy correction; digestion_peptides is the same count with the decoy sequences subtracted.

fields.name: proteins
fields.description: Distinct protein accessions of PSMs that also pass the protein q-value, which only proteotypic peptides can.

fields.name: q_value
fields.description: Spectrum, peptide and protein q-value threshold every count in this row used.

fields.name: digestion_peptides
fields.description: The `peptides` column of this file's digestion.tsv row: the same distinct target sequences minus the distinct decoy sequences passing the same filter, floored at zero, which is the denominator of the four digestion percentages in this row. Lower than `peptides` by the number of decoy sequences, so the two differ by how many identifications at this threshold are expected to be false.

fields.name: missed_cleavage_pct
fields.description: Percent of digestion_peptides with at least one missed cleavage.

fields.name: semi_n_pct
fields.description: Percent of digestion_peptides with a non-enzymatic N-terminus only.

fields.name: semi_c_pct
fields.description: Percent of digestion_peptides with a non-enzymatic C-terminus only.

fields.name: non_enzymatic_pct
fields.description: Percent of digestion_peptides with two non-enzymatic termini.

fields.name: top_polymer
fields.description: Polymer carrying the largest share of this file's MS1 total ion current, or `-` when the file's MS1 spectra were not read or no polymer is configured.

fields.name: top_polymer_tic_pct
fields.description: That polymer's percent of the scanned centroided MS1 total ion current, as reported in run-summary.json under qc.polymers; zero when top_polymer is `-`.

fields.name: largest_shift_residue
fields.description: Residue whose observed share in this file differs most from the share the search database predicts for the same proteins, from qc.composition.tsv. Empty when no residue has a finite log2 ratio, for example when nothing was identified.

fields.name: largest_shift_log2_ratio
fields.description: That residue's `log2(observed_fraction / expected_fraction)`, four decimals. Empty with largest_shift_residue: an absent shift is not a shift of zero.

fields.name: jensen_shannon_distance
fields.description: Jensen-Shannon distance between this file's observed and expected composition profiles, four decimals: 0 for identical profiles, 1 for profiles with no residue in common. Empty when either profile counted no residues.

fields.name: charge_1_pct
fields.description: Percent of this file's confident precursors at charge 1, from qc.chromatography.tsv. Empty when that pass counted no precursor in this file.

fields.name: charge_2_pct
fields.description: Percent at charge 2.

fields.name: charge_3_pct
fields.description: Percent at charge 3.

fields.name: charge_4_plus_pct
fields.description: Percent at charge 4 or above.

fields.name: charge_unknown_pct
fields.description: Percent whose charge the file did not state, so the five charge columns sum to 100.

fields.name: peak_width
fields.description: Chromatographic peak width in this file's retention-time unit, from qc.chromatography.tsv. Empty when neither source had anything to measure.

fields.name: peak_width_kind
fields.description: Which quantity peak_width is: `lfq_median_fwhm` with quantification, otherwise the repeat-PSM spread (`repeat_psm_spread`, or `repeat_psm_spread_fallback` where the file had too few repeats). Empty with peak_width.

fields.name: quantified_precursors
fields.description: Precursors with an integrated intensity in this file. Empty without quantification.

fields.name: transferred_pct
fields.description: Percent of those that came from match-between-runs, with no direct MS2 evidence in this file. Empty without quantification or with nothing quantified.

fields.name: modifications_searched
fields.description: Searched variable-modification definitions reported for this file in qc.modifications.tsv. Empty when no modification was searched.

fields.name: top_modification
fields.description: The definition with the highest occupancy in this file, named as qc.modifications.tsv names it: the configured name, or the site rule and mass for a definition given as a bare mass. Empty when no modification was searched.

fields.name: top_modification_occupancy_pct
fields.description: That definition's modified sites as a percent of its eligible sites in this file.

fields.name: contaminant_psms
fields.description: Confident PSMs of this file whose peptide belongs to a contaminant protein, from run-summary.json under contaminants.files. Empty without a `database.contaminant_fasta`.

fields.name: contaminant_psm_pct
fields.description: Those PSMs as a percent of this file's confident PSMs, as run-summary.json reports it under contaminants.files. Empty without a contaminant FASTA.

fields.name: in_source_flagged_psms
fields.description: PSMs of this file flagged as in-source fragmentation or in-source neutral-loss products. Empty when `in_source` is off.

fields.name: gradient_bins
fields.description: Retention-time bins this file was split into in qc.gradient.tsv; 10 for a file with spectra, 0 for one without.

fields.name: empty_gradient_bins
fields.description: Bins that acquired MS2 spectra and identified none: a dead region of the gradient, or a spray dropout. A bin that acquired no MS2 spectrum is not counted here, because nothing was tried in it; those are no_ms2_gradient_bins. qc.gradient.tsv names the bins.

fields.name: no_ms2_gradient_bins
fields.description: Bins that acquired no MS2 spectrum at all, which is ordinary at the start and end of a gradient; those bins have no identification rate and are excluded from empty_gradient_bins, min_bin_identified_pct and max_bin_identified_pct.

fields.name: min_bin_identified_pct
fields.description: Lowest ms2_identified_pct among the bins that acquired MS2 spectra; zero when none did.

fields.name: max_bin_identified_pct
fields.description: Highest ms2_identified_pct among those bins; zero when none did.
